parameters.query: SELECT * FROM students WHERE cohort = 'Spring 2024' LIMIT 1

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value: Generate a coding task for a student bootcamp. The task should be: 1) Practical and hands-on 2) Suitable for intermediate level students 3) Include clear learning objectives 4) Have estimated duration of 60-120 minutes. Format as JSON with fields: title, description, difficulty_level, category, estimated_duration, learning_objectives (array).

parameters.query: INSERT INTO student_tasks (student_id, task_id, assigned_date, due_date) SELECT s.id, (SELECT id FROM tasks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' FROM students s WHERE s.cohort = 'Spring 2024'
